marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Do Re Mi tells of three friends, Masdur or Do (P.Ramlee), Amore or Re (AR Tompel) and Minami or Mi (Ibrahim Din) who are struggling to find jobs and households. Do, a man who ignored the household and owed a lot, had deceived his father-in-law to earn some money. Do and his wife then parted due to the unreasonable. Do move into the city to start a new life. Re has a wife working at the nightclub, while she owns the home. Due to the negligence of Re who caused his wife's money to be stolen, she was driven out of the house and brought herself to work in the city. Mi, a young man who is interested in a girl who is facing her house, Milah (Wan Chik Daud), is often lucky that the girl is willing to lend money to her who does not work. When Mi came out to find work, he helped chase the thief who grabbed a woman's handbag. Do and Re, who are looking for work at the labor office, heard the woman's scream, then chased Mi running, thinking she was a thief. So since then, the three of them are close friends and there are various funny things happened. Various challenges of three companions in search of life and endless life.
